name: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live
access: Gemini API (Live API over WebSockets or Google GenAI SDK)
Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (distribution listed in the shared model card; Cloud limits not reverified)

voice.input_audio: Raw 16-bit mono little-endian PCM at 16 kHz, audio/pcm;rate=16000. Guide recommends 100 ms chunks but also says 1,024 to 2,048 frames, which does not specify one exact duration [transcribe-live-guide]
voice.output_audio: None: the model returns text, not generated speech
languages: 85+ supported languages and locales; the full BCP-47 table is on the model page [transcribe-model]
voice.turn_detection: Automatic server VAD by default; hybrid audio_stream_end finalization or manual activity_start/activity_end with automatic detection disabled [transcribe-live-guide]
voice.interruption: Not a speaking assistant; no generated speech to interrupt
voice.session_limit: Up to 10 minutes of continuous streaming per session; no transcription-specific longer-session guarantee found [transcribe-live-guide]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Gemini API Standard paid plan. Input is audio and output is text, USD per million tokens. Pricing page estimates 25 audio tokens/second and 175 text tokens/minute, about $0.009 per minute combined; actual token use determines the bill. Free tier offered [pricing]

benchmarks.setting: Percent word error rate, lower is better. Google reports an Artificial Analysis result; the current independent streaming page exposes no Gemini row in the text read, so this is not treated as a current independent verification
benchmarks.harness: Artificial Analysis streaming transcription, as reproduced in Google model evaluation
